files.description: RFC Markdown files as globs relative to the input root. Left out, docs/rfc/*.md, docs/rfcs/*.md and docs/rfd/*.md.

scope.description: Default scope when a document does not declare one: org, a context, or <context>.<service>.

prefix.description: Display prefix for documents whose heading and metadata do not name one. Defaults to RFC.

repo.description: Repository that owns these RFC files, as host/owner/name. The repository pin carries the extracted commit.

history.description: Read authorship and activity from file history, or none for a non-checkout fixture.

statusMap.description: Company-specific source status to Portolan lifecycle mapping. Keys are matched case-insensitively.

out.description: Fragment file name. Defaults to rfc.json.
